scope_note: Covers instruments that amend Regulation (EU) No 1306/2013 as it has effect in Scotland, and the framework under which it was retained and can be modified. Deliberately NOT a complete list: see the note in the answer. Limited to legislation.

steps.title: Establish how the Regulation was retained
steps.detail: Identify the routes by which Regulation (EU) No 1306/2013 became domestic law as it applies in Scotland.

steps.title: Identify instruments that amend the Regulation directly
steps.detail: Find UK statutory instruments whose operative provisions are headed as amending Regulation (EU) 1306/2013, and confirm from their text what each amends.

steps.title: Identify the Scottish modification framework
steps.detail: Retrieve the Scottish primary legislation that defines the Regulation and confers power to modify it.

steps.title: State the limits of the list
steps.detail: Record what could not be established, so the answer does not present a partial list as exhaustive.
